Issue: dp[i]+1 — moving from component i to j with A increasing gives +1, correct since dp counts vertices. Base case dp=1. But edges only added in one direction: A[u]<A[v]. If A equal they union. Sorting components by AA works. Bug candidates: line 146 dp update uses dp[i] even if dp[i]==-inf, giving -inf+1... but max won't accept. Actually -inf+1 > -inf, could propagate through unreachable nodes incorrectly! Actually ans=-inf+1 not equal -inf, prints huge negative? No, prints -inf+1, wrong. Real issue: should check dp[i]!=-inf. Line 146 main suspect. Also line 127 direction: if A[u]>A[v] swap so u smaller, fine. Line 144 sorting ties order arbitrary but within same value components no edges between them (united). OK. Line 143 base case fine.

Also note line 146 propagates from dp[i] that is -inf; score high for line 146. Maybe line 141 sentinel value.
